label: spec given
sources: Costs and bounds are "given" [@altman1999]; a cost function and a "maximum allowed cumulative cost" [@satija2020]; a threshold "known at time h" [@wachi2023]; a temporal-logic specification [@alshiekh2018]
search_terms: safety specification; safety constraint; cost function; safety cost

label: model given
sources: Transition probabilities enter the linear program [@altman1999]; "transition certainty" [@mohammedalamen2025a]; "complete and correct model of the world dynamics" [@kaelbling1998]; a "conservative" abstraction [@alshiekh2018]
search_terms: transition probabilit; transition model; known dynamics; model-based; transition function; transition matri

label: finite
sources: "a finite number of states" [@altman1999, Part I]; "A finite, discounted MDP" [@mohammedalamen2025a]; "finite or countably infinite" states for the guarantees of @mohammedalamen2025b; "a finite set of states" [@kaelbling1998]

label: observed by agent
sources: "fully-observable" state [@wachi2023]; "fully observable" environments [@mohammedalamen2025a]; policies of the state [@altman1999; @satija2020]
search_terms: fully observable; fully-observable; partially observable; partial observability; observability

label: learner controlled
definition: Designer controls the learner's update (we count adaptation in context as an update)
sources: Updates "sufficiently slowly" [@satija2020]; in part, a learner filtered to a certified safe set [@wachi2023]
search_terms: policy update; step size; learning rate; trust region; slowly

label: repeat or recover
definition: Trials repeat, or every state is recoverable within the decision process (by the agent, or by a reset it can use)
sources: "ergodic for any policy" [@satija2020]; an emergency stop that resets "the environment" [@wachi2023]; every state "visited infinitely often" [@mohammedalamen2025b]; constraints on expectations [@altman1999]
